conversion.row_order: ASCII lexical order by logical operator name; exactly one row per active exact ID.
conversion.identity: operator_id is the reviewed exact registry ID; a live subject must match its class, module, source path, and source SHA-256.

result_projection.output_data: Preserve group and record order, key sets, scalar types, and values.
result_projection.output_attributes: Preserve exact keys and ordinary value types.
result_projection.is_empty: Require an actual Boolean and distinguish successful-empty from failure.
result_projection.errors: Project each error to exact code and stage.
result_projection.floating_point: Regression results use pytest approximate equality; reference prose records the behavior, not exact floats.
result_projection.non_json_inputs: No non-JSON input transform is admitted.

evidence_schemas.cases: Named product regression tests supply the input and expected assertion for each case ID.
evidence_schemas.observations: No runtime-observation schema is used by this supplement.

rows.name: sklearn_estimator

success.summary: A lower-case LinearRegression name trains on the first group and predicts the later group.

empty.summary: An empty bundle returns the original empty input from the raw compatibility call.

invalid.summary: An unknown estimator is INVALID_INPUT at VALIDATE through structured run.

failure.summary: A fit_predict-only estimator with later inference data fails at EXECUTE instead of refitting.

dependency_profile.setup: Install the ml extra; package import remains independent of NumPy and scikit-learn.

discriminators: Case-insensitive lookup and a dynamic constructor parameter are exercised together.
One fitted model is distinguished from independent per-group fit_predict calls.
